title: Socio-technical and Ethical Dimensions of Architecture Practices in FLOSS
abstract: arXiv:2609.09975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This project investigates how software architecture practices in Free/Libre Open Source Software (FLOSS) are shaped by socio-technical and ethical factors, and how education can support more explicit, inclusive, and reflective architectural work. Motivated by FLOSS's role in digital sovereignty, it is observed that architectural decisions are often undocumented and scattered across issues, pull requests, and mailing lists. While prior research has studied architectural artifacts, erosion, and communication, the interplay between architectural work, governance arrangements, and ethical commitments in FLOSS remains underexplored. The research follows a three-phase design: (1) multi-method case studies of 3-4 domain-pairs of architecturally non-trivial FLOSS projects, (2) framework and intervention design with practitioners and educators, and (3) pilot evaluations in projects and courses. translated_title: FLOSS（自由/开源软件）中架构实践的社会技术与伦理维度
translated_abstract: 本项目研究自由/开源软件（FLOSS）中的软件架构实践如何受到社会技术因素和伦理因素的影响，以及教育如何支持更加明确、包容和反思性的架构工作。出于对FLOSS在数字主权中作用的关注，研究者观察到架构决策往往缺乏文档记录，且散布在议题、拉取请求和邮件列表之中。尽管已有研究探讨了架构制品、架构侵蚀和架构沟通，但FLOSS中架构工作、治理安排与伦理承诺之间的相互作用仍未得到充分探索。该研究采用三阶段设计：（1）对3-4对具有非平凡架构的FLOSS项目开展多方法案例研究；（2）与从业者和教育者共同设计框架与干预措施；（3）在项目和课程中进行试点评估。该项目将产出：（i）跨案例的实证证据……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本项目通过多方法案例研究、框架与干预设计及试点评估，探索FLOSS架构实践中社会技术因素与伦理承诺的交互作用，并通过教育促进更明确、包容和反思性的架构决策。
en_tdlr: This project investigates how socio-technical and ethical factors shape software architecture practices in FLOSS through multi-method case studies, framework and intervention design, and pilot evaluations, aiming to support more explicit, inclusive, and reflective architectural decision-making through education.
